'''Taien''' was a small town in the eastern end of the [[Jangai Pass]], in [[Cairhien]].

==Appearance==
Taien has a high wall. It is located in the [[Spine of the World]]. It lies at the foot of a huge monument referred to by the inhabitants as the "cliff snake".{{ref/book|5|20}} 

==Recent events==
When [[Couladin]] and the [[Shaido]] [[Aiel]] travel from [[Alcair Dal]] to the city of [[Cairhien (city)|Cairhien]], they stop and decimate the town of Taien. Later, when [[Rand al'Thor]] and his group come to the city, they take the one hundred refugees, including [[Ander Corl]], [[Aril Corl]], and [[Tal Nethin]], with them.{{ref/book|5|21}}
